definition_template: Number of {cells} per mm3 of processed tissue (numerical density, Nv)
notes: Depends on tissue shrinkage and on how section thickness was measured; compare within one counting-method family (pooling rule PR04). Totals are more robust across studies than densities.

definition_template: Total number of {cells} in the structure (N)
notes: Usually optical fractionator, or Nv multiplied by a Cavalieri reference volume; record whether one hemisphere or both.

definition_template: Fraction of all glia in the same region that are {cells}
notes: Usually the mean of per-animal ratios, which is not the ratio of the two density means (Munger et al. 2022).

definition_template: Percentage of all neurons in the same region that are {cells}
Glial cells per neuron counted in the same sections (glia-neuron ratio, GNR)
notes: A histological GNR separates glia from endothelial cells; the isotropic fractionator's non-neuron to neuron ratio (nNNR) does not, so the two are never pooled (pooling rule PR03).

definition_template: Number of {cells} under 1 mm2 of cortical surface, through the full cortical depth
notes: Pooling with fractionator values is held for expert review (pooling rule PR06).

definition_template: Number of {cells} per mm2 of tissue section (two-dimensional profile density)
notes: Depends on section thickness and cell size; never pooled across studies (pooling rule PR05).
